scope: Visually reviewed crops from checksum-bound original GATE CS question-paper PDFs

crops.alt_text: Partially completed deterministic finite automaton with accepting states labelled epsilon, 0, 1, 00, 01, 10, and 11, plus a non-accepting state q.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2012 Q46 partially completed DFA.

crops.alt_text: Four answer-option transition tables labelled A through D for the missing arcs of the partially completed DFA.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2012 Q46 transition-table answer options.

crops.alt_text: A path from source S through two routers labelled R to destination D, connected in a straight line.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2013 Q14 source-router-destination path.

crops.alt_text: Allocation and Max matrices for processes P0, P1, and P2 over resource types X, Y, and Z.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2014 Set 1 Q31 Banker algorithm state table.

crops.alt_text: Host A connected in sequence to routers R1 and R2 and then to host B.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2014 Set 2 Q26 store-and-forward path.

crops.alt_text: Line graph of cache miss rate percentage against cache size in megabytes, decreasing from 80 percent at 10 MB to 15 percent at 80 MB.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2016 Set 2 Q50 cache miss-rate graph.

crops.alt_text: Campus map divided by 1st Main Road and 5th Cross Road, with the library and physics lab to the west, canteen and hospital to the east, hostels and classrooms southwest, chemistry lab southeast, and a north arrow.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2025 Set 1 Q5 campus-direction map.

crops.alt_text: Triangle PQR with points S and T on sides PQ and PR, respectively, and segment ST parallel to base QR.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2025 Set 1 Q7 triangle and parallel segment.

crops.alt_text: Four stages show a square folded twice into a triangle and cut at three positions; below them are four square unfolding-pattern options labelled A through D.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2025 Set 1 Q9 paper-folding stages and answer diagrams.

crops.alt_text: Routing table with prefixes 145.36.0.0/16 to E1, 145.36.128.0/17 to E2, 145.36.64.0/18 to E3, 145.36.255.0/24 to E4, and the default route to E5.

crops.alt_text: Processor feeds an L1 cache with 95 percent hit rate and 10 ns access, then an L2 cache with 85 percent hit rate and 20 ns access including the L1 miss penalty, then main memory with 200 ns access including both cache miss penalties.

crops.alt_text: Four database instance tables labelled player, coach, team, and members, showing their identifiers, names, ages, cities, coach identifiers, and team memberships.

crops.alt_text: Path from source through Router-1 with MTU 5000 bytes and Router-2 with MTU 3000 bytes to the destination.

crops.alt_text: State transition table for present states A through H, with next-state and output columns for inputs X equals 0 and X equals 1.

crops.alt_text: Four clocked D flip-flops D0 through D3 form a chain with outputs Q0 through Q3, a shared clock, and feedback from complemented Q3 to the first flip-flop.

crops.alt_text: Linked list L1 contains 1, 7, 12, 3, 9, 5, 11, 15, 8; linked list L2 contains 1, 11, 6, 9, 15, 12, 4; both terminate at null.

crops.alt_text: A six-square cube net marked with a filled circle, open circle, open triangle, and filled triangle, followed by four cube options labelled A through D.

crops.alt_text: For iterations 0 through 3, inputs are 20, minus 4, 10, 15; output X is 20, 16, 26, 41; output Y is 20, minus 80, minus 800, minus 12000.

crops.alt_text: Square PQRS overlapped by tilted rectangle PLMN, with L on side QR and side MN passing through S.

crops.alt_text: Unlabelled tree with two main branching regions joined by an edge and multiple leaf vertices at varying depths.

crops.alt_text: Logic circuit with inputs X and Y feeding a NAND gate, two inverters, a lower AND gate, and a final OR gate whose output is F.

Original GATE CS 2024 Set 1 Q35 relation tables R and S.

crops.alt_text: Four-by-four grid whose first three rows are 1, X, 4, 3; X, 5, 5, 4; and 3, X, 6, X, with all four cells of the last row blank.

crops.alt_text: Two-state DFA with a non-accepting initial state and an accepting state; input 0 loops on each state, while input 1 transitions in both directions between the states.
crops.caption: Original GATE CS 2024 Set 2 Q22 two-state DFA.

crops.alt_text: Five-state NFA with initial state 1, accepting states 2 and 5, epsilon transitions from 1 to 2 and 4 and from 3 to 5, 0-labelled transitions between 2 and 3, and 1-labelled transitions between 4 and 5.

crops.alt_text: Eight-row triples table numbered 0 through 7; rows 1, 3, and 6 are blank, while other rows show plus p r, uminus (1), division u w, plus (3) (4), and assignment (6) (5).

crops.alt_text: Inputs f1 and f2 feed an AND gate, inputs f3 and f4 feed an OR gate, and the two gate outputs feed an XOR gate whose output is Y.

crops.alt_text: Weighted undirected graph on vertices a, b, c, d, e, f, and central vertex g; outer side edges have weight 1, edges incident on g have weight 2, and edges b-c and f-e have weight 3.

crops.alt_text: Unlabelled undirected graph with eight vertices arranged as two rows of four, outer slanted and horizontal edges, vertical links, and four crossing diagonal edges.

no_asset_reviews.rationale: The symbol-table question and its four options are entirely textual; the following page begins a different question and supplies no shared visual.
The demand-paging stem and answer choices contain only prose and numeric expressions; the next page contains a separate database question.
The minimum-spanning-tree distance question is expressed entirely in text and formulas; the following page starts an unrelated grammar question.
The graph-diameter and BFS-tree-height question uses only symbolic prose and textual options; the next page is a separate language question.
The phrase following keys refers to the listed insertion sequence, not to a figure; the complete double-hashing problem is textual.
The letter-coding analogy and every answer choice are textual; the following page starts a separate tabular iteration question.
The BFS and DFS statements are fully specified in prose without a drawn graph; the following page contains a separate matching table.
Waveform is a measured quantity in the prose, not a displayed image; the ripple-counter question contains no diagram or table.
The edge-weight update question is entirely textual and symbolic; the following page starts an unrelated meld-operation question.
All resource-allocation assignment and claim edges are enumerated in text, so no external graph is required; the following page starts another question.
The two-level paging question is fully specified in prose and powers of two; the tree drawn later on the page belongs only to question 59.

paper_no_asset_reviews.rationale: All 36 checksum-bound original-paper pages were visually reviewed. The listed parent slots are fully represented by prose, mathematics, code, or answer text and do not require an external image; the paper's separate visual-dependent slots have exact crop overrides.
